hackathon_faqs.question: Is there any registration fee to participate in GeNarrative Clash?
hackathon_faqs.answer: **No, participation is completely free!** There are no entry fees or hidden costs to register, build, or compete in the hackathon.

hackathon_faqs.question: Who can participate? Is the hackathon open to working professionals?
hackathon_faqs.answer: **GeNarrative Clash** is exclusively for currently enrolled university and college students. Working professionals are not eligible to compete as participants, though they are **welcome to join us as mentors or judges.**

hackathon_faqs.question: Do I need to be a Computer Science student to participate?
hackathon_faqs.answer: **Not at all!** Since this hackathon merges Generative AI with the creative arts, we strongly encourage students from design, media, literature, and other non-technical backgrounds to form teams with developers. **Diverse perspectives build the best tools.**

hackathon_faqs.question: Can our team have members from different colleges or universities?
hackathon_faqs.answer: **Yes, Cross-college and inter-disciplinary teams are absolutely allowed.** As long as every member is a currently enrolled student, you can team up with anyone you want.

hackathon_faqs.question: What is the allowed team size?
hackathon_faqs.answer: Teams can consist of anywhere from **2 to 4 members**. We highly recommend having a mix of technical developers and creative designers on your squad.

hackathon_faqs.question: Is the hackathon held entirely online or in person?
hackathon_faqs.answer: **It is a hybrid event.** The first round is online, where you will build and submit your 50% project prototype in between November 10th to November 16th . **The top 150** shortlisted teams will then be invited to Techno India University, Kolkata, on November 21st for the offline 6-hour hack sprint and live final pitches.

hackathon_faqs.question: What exactly do we need to submit for the online evaluation round?
hackathon_faqs.answer: Your online submission must include a **GitHub repository link** demonstrating at least 50% code completion, a clean and **comprehensive README file** explaining your tool, and a **live video demonstration link** showing your working prototype in action.

hackathon_faqs.question: What should we bring if our team is shortlisted for the in-person finale?
hackathon_faqs.answer: Bring your laptops, chargers, any specialized hardware you need, and a valid **college student ID card**. We will provide the **workspace, power outlets, Wi-Fi, and an AI masterclass to kick off the day.**

*Where Generative AI Meets Human Creativity*

Are you ready to redefine how stories are told, music is composed, and digital art is created? **GeNarrative Clash** is Kolkata's premier Prompt Engineering & AI Building Challenge, organized by the GeeksforGeeks Student Chapter at Techno India University.

---

Don't worry if you are new to AI development! Before the live challenge kicks off, every participant gets access to an exclusive **1-Hour Hands-On Masterclass on AI Development & API Integration**. Learn how to harness cutting-edge LLMs, query GenAI APIs, and leverage rapid prototyping tools so you can build a solid, production-ready product with confidence.

* **Exclusive Swags:** Official sponsor goodies for top 12 finalists.
